item.title: Luggin | LOG Series Cute Bread Suitcase Lightweight Carry‑on Suitcase Rear Cup Holder Double Wheels Quiet Travel Luggage 20"行李箱
item.description:
【LOG Series】
The LOG Series is a cute and novel bread‑shaped suitcase. It features lightweight material and a unique panel pattern. The rear cup holder allows you to place a water bottle or bubble tea anytime, while the double‑wheel design ensures smooth rolling. Inside, the 210D polyester lining includes a full‑zipper compartment with a zippered pocket on one side and an adjustable luggage strap on the other. Available in 20" carry‑on size and multiple colors.

📍 Product Details
► Exterior design: bread shape, cute and novel, unique panel pattern
► Material: ABS+PC, lightweight and impact‑resistant
► Wheels: double rollers, 360° rotation, stable and smooth
► Lock: standard combination lock system, settable 3‑digit password for security
► Rear cup holder: foldable cup holder for water bottles or bubble tea – hands‑free convenience
► Interior structure: 210D polyester lining; one side features a full‑zipper compartment + zippered pocket; the other side has an adjustable luggage strap

📍 Size & Weight
20" / approx. 46 × 26.5 × 53.5 cm / approx. 2.94 kg
(Includes wheels and handle)

📍 Multiple Colors Available
Pink / Purple / Yellow / White / Haze Blue

📍 Warranty Policy
5‑year warranty: covers key components such as wheels, handle, lock, and zippers (specific terms subject to purchase agreement)
